work: La Science et l'Hypothèse / Science and Hypothesis
author: Jules Henri Poincaré (1854–1912)
copyright_status: 100% Public Domain Worldwide (original French published Paris 1902, author died 1912; English translations published London & New York 1905)

witnesses.title: La Science et l'Hypothèse
witnesses.edition: Paris: Ernest Flammarion, Bibliothèque de Philosophie scientifique, 1902 (collated with definitive Flammarion printing containing 'Les Géométries de Hilbert', pp. 63–64)
witnesses.coverage: Introduction (pp. 1–7), Part I Chs. I–II (pp. 9–48), Part II Chs. III–V (pp. 49–109), Part III Chs. VI–VII, Part IV Ch. IX

witnesses.title: Science and Hypothesis (trans. William John Greenstreet, Preface by Joseph Larmor)
witnesses.edition: London & Newcastle-on-Tyne: Walter Scott Publishing Co., Ltd., 1905
witnesses.coverage: Larmor Preface (pp. ix–xx), Author's Preface (pp. xxi–xxvii), Part I Chs. I–II (pp. 1–34), Part II Chs. III–V (pp. 35–88), Part III Chs. VI–VII, Part IV Ch. IX

witnesses.title: Science and Hypothesis (trans. George Bruce Halsted, with Special Preface by Henri Poincaré and Introduction by Josiah Royce)
witnesses.edition: New York: The Science Press, 1905 (reprinted in The Foundations of Science, 1913)
witnesses.coverage: Complete American edition including Poincaré's Author's Preface to the Translation and Parts I–IV (Chs. I–XIII)
